model_class: protocol-aware plant single-cell expression encoder with species-adaptation interfaces, hierarchical annotation paths and a runtime annotation head
central_contribution: Plant-CellFM treats cross-species plant annotation as an evidence-chain problem: gene-transfer assumptions, label-space coverage, nested selection, few-shot adaptation and deployment inference are recorded and reported as distinct protocols.
claim_scope: The frozen evidence establishes reproducible behavior on a defined public plant single-cell corpus and an 8-species cross-species evaluation panel. It does not establish uniformly high-accuracy annotation for every plant, every tissue or every unobserved cell state.

architecture.adaptation: LoRA adapters with a runtime adapter-resolution interface
architecture.gene_transfer: exact gene identifiers followed by an explicit ortholog-mapping contract when a compatible map is supplied

frozen_current_corpus.boundary: Historical catalogue rows, adapter registry entries and evaluation-only species are not equivalent to cells in the frozen profiled corpus.

primary_strict_leave_species_v17.selection: nested source-species selection for every outer held-out species

identity_curated_companion_v18.role: label-integrity companion; never substitutes for v17
identity_curated_companion_v18.filter_rule: labels beginning unknown, unknow or unannotated are audit-only and never fit or score identities

exploratory_global_context_v14.reporting_boundary: Exploratory sensitivity result only. It is not the primary strict headline because configuration choice pools information across outer folds.

runtime_full_vocabulary_head.role: deployment analysis, not strict zero-shot transfer

gse297576_sorghum_root_external_screen_a.role: Source-pinned author-labelled external-species screen followed by a sealed-library target-species adaptation case.
gse297576_sorghum_root_external_screen_a.boundary: The frozen external screen is a true species-absent audit but has low raw performance. The high-scoring result is an author-label-supervised, library-held-out Sorghum adaptation and must not be reported as strict zero-shot or third-party superiority.

matched_checkpoint_evidence.boundary: These values compare frozen project checkpoints on the same benchmark contract. They are not external-model rankings.

literature_concordance.boundary: Canonical markers were fixed from primary literature before lookup. This supports biological plausibility only; it is not wet-lab validation or independent-matrix replication.

gse152766_blind_external_root_inference.boundary: The downloaded external matrix contains no expert cell-type labels. This is a blind model-execution and fixed-marker-coherence audit, not external accuracy, a matched model comparison or independent experimental validation.

gse270140_secondary_root_labelled_adapta.role: Within-dataset, author-label-supervised secondary-root adaptation of the frozen root checkpoint.
gse270140_secondary_root_labelled_adapta.tuning_mode: LoRA-mode; rank 8; embedding, normalization and annotation-head parameters remain trainable under the recorded configuration.
gse270140_secondary_root_labelled_adapta.boundary: Author-label-supervised cell-level adaptation inside one secondary-root sample. It is not zero-shot, leave-species evidence, independent external validation or a matched third-party benchmark.

gse270342_wheat_root_labelled_adaptation.role: Barcode-non-overlap, same-study author-label-supervised allopolyploid wheat-root adaptation of the frozen root checkpoint.

orthology_contract.mapping_source: Author-published custom PLAZA orthogroup table; deterministic first-target frozen projection with a separately reported count-conserving mean sensitivity.

gse270342_wheat_root_labelled_adaptation.tuning_mode: LoRA-mode; rank 8; the recorded adapter configuration is initialized from the frozen 256-dimensional root checkpoint.
gse270342_wheat_root_labelled_adaptation.boundary: A same-study author-label-supervised, cell-level split after excluding exact barcode overlap with a historical exploratory strict-transfer subset. This is not zero-shot, independent external validation or a matched third-party benchmark. The eight-label direct-root recovery is a predefined subset and does not replace the 13-class author-label test metric.

intended_uses: construct plant single-cell or single-nucleus embeddings under the documented gene contract
run a correctly labelled strict-transfer, few-shot-adaptation or runtime-annotation workflow
derive ranked marker candidates for experimental follow-up or atlas curation
instantiate a species adapter after supplying compatible gene identifiers or an ortholog map and validating on held-out cells
not_established: universal high-accuracy zero-shot annotation across all plants
official numerical superiority over scPlantLLM or scPlantAnnotate
a completed Saussurea involucrata single-cell atlas
wet-lab validation of the Arabidopsis root marker candidates

comparison_status.scPlantLLM: official checkpoint execution, locked shared GSE270342 test reference, partial-adaptation replay and full-backbone-adaptation replay completed; this same-study reference is not an external model ranking
